name: Capture from high-purity CO2 streams (compression and dehydration only)
principle: Some plants already separate CO2 as part of their process, for example acid gas removal in gas processing or fermentation in ethanol plants. Capture then only needs the CO2 to be compressed, cooled and dried to pipeline specification, which makes these the lowest-cost capture opportunities.

process_steps.name: Vented CO2 from the process unit
equipment: existing acid gas removal or fermentation vent

process_steps.name: Export to pipeline or storage
equipment: export pump or final compression stage

costs.metric: cost of CO2 captured, natural gas processing (greenfield)
costs.basis: NETL; compression with intercooling and possibly glycol dehydration

source.note: NETL, Cost of Capturing CO2 from Industrial Sources, 15 July 2022, Exhibit ES-2 (p. 2)

advantages: No solvent or separation unit to add
limitations: Limited to the CO2 a process already separates; the rest of the site's emissions (furnaces, utilities) need another route
